name: std::make_obj_using_allocator

declarations.code:
template <class T, class Alloc, class... Args>

constexpr T make_obj_using_allocator(const Alloc &alloc, Args &&...args);

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
alloc

 -

 the allocator to use


 args

 -

 the arguments to pass to T's constructor

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: The newly-created object of type T.

sections.title: Exceptions
sections.text: May throw any exception thrown by the constructor of T, typically including std::bad_alloc.

summary: Creates an object of the given type T by means of uses-allocator construction.

recommendedExamples.title: Related example: std::make_unique, std::make_unique_for_overwrite
